hints.title: Transform Numbers by Parity
hints.text: Treat each odd number as 1 and each even number as 0, transforming the task into finding subarrays with sum equal to k.

hints.title: Maintain Prefix Sum Frequencies
hints.text: Store the frequency of each cumulative odd count encountered so far in a lookup table initialized with 0 mapped to 1.

hints.title: Add Matching Prefix Counts
hints.text: At each index with running sum s, add frequency of s minus k to the total count of nice subarrays.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def numberOfSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        count = Counter({0: 1})
        cur = 0
        ans = 0
        for x in nums:
            cur += x % 2
            ans += count[cur - k]
            count[cur] += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all subarrays directly takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix frequency hashing solves the sum count in a single linear pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the isomorphism between counting odds and the subarray sum equals k problem.
complexity.notes: Initial state prefix 0 has frequency 1 to account for subarrays starting at index 0.
